report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'object has', 'objects have')} an assignment naming a missing filter

messages.businessImpact: The assignment names a filter that the tenant no longer has, so its intended target cannot be verified from the current configuration.
remediation: Remove the stale filter reference and attach an existing filter after checking the intended device target.
messages.cannotSee: The filter list and every supported assignable workload must be collected successfully. If any required area is unavailable, the rule skips rather than treating an unread filter as deleted.
